overview_description.description: Stoa is building market infrastructure for AI hardware, starting with Stoa Markets, a platform for institutional GPU supply, sourcing, and price discovery. The company helps buyers, sellers, brokers, operators, and capital partners transact around GPUs with better market visibility, turning private hardware flow into clearer pricing, liquidity, and financial context for the AI infrastructure ecosystem.
